summary: Whole-chapter independent reading completed: all 39 Chinese source units, 80 owned temporal/hint items and 21 people were individually reviewed. This is the Song Suishu publication colophon, not a foreign-ruler chapter; no foreign-ruler or ancestor identity was inferred. Nine actionable finding groups cover Wude month-12 events wrongly put in 622 instead of Gregorian 623, former/later office-date attribution, unsupported dates for Jing Bo, maternal mourning misassigned as the mother's activity/exact death, Chu's borrowed compilation window, and Huang's overprecise replacement year. Two office checks retain research holds. Supported events retain ruler/era identities, verified calendar conventions and exact Chinese evidence. No stated local birth or age was omitted, and the implied maternal death is preserved conservatively. Later editorial credits are not living attestations. This report does not repair, record, publish or approve the extraction.

itemChecks.event: Wang Shao compiled an eighty-juan Sui history during Kaihuang and Renshou.
itemChecks.reason: The Chinese dates Wang Shao himself, not the Sui events he narrated. Calendar witnesses identify Sui Wendi Kaihuang beginning in conventional AD 581 and Renshou ending with year 4, conventional AD 604. AD 581-604 is acceptable only as the explicitly named era window for this work, not evidence that he worked in every year or was born/died at its endpoints. No narrower personal date appears here.
